name: Card
summary: A bordered surface that groups related content behind a title.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-card> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `card-title` renders the header, the default slot is the body, slot="extra" holds a header action, and `hoverable` lifts the card on hover. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: card-title
props.desc: Renders the header row; omit for a bare body

props.name: hoverable
props.desc: Lift the card (border + shadow) on hover

props.name: extra
props.desc: Right-aligned header action (a link or button)

whenToUse.when: grouping related content into a titled surface on a dashboard or settings page
many uniform rows of the same shape
read-only label/value pairs about one entity

opinion.note: Titles are sentence case and name the group — 'Live results', not 'LIVE RESULTS'. Keep one idea per card; reach for hoverable only when the whole card is clickable.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no Card cell; spec derived from the token layer (radius-lg, border, split, bg-container, text-default/secondary) + antd Card conventions (16/24 header, 20 body). A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: hover lifts via motion tokens (persistent node)

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
